name: MariaDB Server
line: Self-hosted SQL database with event scheduling and vector search.

free.text: Free GPLv2 server; no provider quota or hosted idle rule; you run it

cells.metered: Community software $0; Enterprise pricing by quote
cells.regions: Choose the region for your own server

sql.math: The Community software license is $0. Host, disk, backups, transfer and operations are not priced.
The software license stays $0. Kept host, data, backups and operations depend on your provider.

files.math: MariaDB Server does not provide file storage.

jobs.math: SQL events have no fee per run, but they use database resources that are not priced. No general worker is included.
